topic: Kitty Hawk, USA, 1903: the Wright brothers made the first powered aeroplane flight, which lasted 12 seconds.

episode.title: Tiny Time Traveler: A 12-Second Wonder!

shots.narration: A sparkle jump—and something amazing waits beyond the sand!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunlit sandy dunes at Kitty Hawk, 3D animated adventure-film style, no writing.
shots.action: Zoya and Tock materialize together inside swirling golden time-travel sparkles.
shots.mood: Bright golden sunlight, glittering dust, welcoming adventure.

shots.narration: We're in Kitty Hawk, USA, in 1903.
shots.scene: Wide sandy landscape with sparse dune grass beneath a clear blue sky, vertical composition.
shots.action: Zoya spreads her arms toward the dunes.
shots.mood: Warm sunlight, open space, cheerful discovery.

shots.narration: [surprised] Whoops! The wind caught Zoya's paper glider!
shots.scene: Sunlit dune slope, Zoya's empty outstretched hand beside a plain unmarked paper glider.
shots.action: The paper glider tumbles away from Zoya through the air.
shots.mood: Playful surprise, fluttering paper, sparkling airborne sand.

shots.narration: It lands just beyond the dune.
shots.scene: Sheltered sandy hollow beyond a grassy dune ridge, no writing or people.
shots.action: The paper glider settles onto the sand.
shots.mood: Soft sunshine, quiet sand, gentle suspense.

shots.scene: Dune crest overlooking a grounded early aeroplane with fabric wings and wooden framework.
shots.action: Tock leans forward over the dune crest toward the aeroplane.
shots.mood: Brass gleaming in sunlight, a grand reveal beyond the ridge.

shots.narration: [excited] The Wright brothers made history here!
shots.scene: Sandy hollow beside a stationary Wright Flyer, with pale fabric wings, exposed framework, and no markings or people.
shots.mood: Bright historical discovery, warm wood, luminous fabric wings.

shots.narration: They made the first powered aeroplane flight.
shots.scene: Grounded Wright Flyer stretching across the sandy clearing, wings stacked against the blue sky.
shots.action: Zoya follows the wing's outline with an admiring upward gesture.
shots.mood: Friendly wonder, sunlit craftsmanship, expansive sky.

shots.scene: Close view of the stationary aeroplane's exposed engine and wooden framework, Tock standing safely apart.
shots.action: Tock tilts his round glass face toward the engine.
shots.mood: Curious inspection, warm metallic highlights, crisp wooden details.

shots.scene: Zoya beside the grounded aeroplane, its fabric wings towering above her yellow hoodie.
shots.action: Zoya lifts her hands to her cheeks.
shots.mood: Wide-eyed amazement, brilliant sunlight, gentle historical wonder.

shots.narration: Zoya finds her little flyer beneath the big one.
shots.scene: Sand beside the grounded aeroplane's wing, plain paper glider within easy reach outside the framework.
shots.action: Zoya picks up her paper glider.
shots.mood: Satisfying discovery, soft wing shadow, warm sand.

shots.narration: Glider rescued, Zoya readies another time jump.
shots.scene: Sunlit dune clearing with the grounded aeroplane behind them, paper glider tucked securely into Zoya's cargo pocket.
shots.action: Zoya presses her glowing blue wristwatch.
shots.mood: Blue watchlight, gathering golden sparkles, cheerful anticipation.

shots.scene: Vertical frame filled with golden time-travel sparkles above the sandy dunes, no visible writing.
shots.action: Tock bounces toward Zoya inside the glowing time-jump halo.
shots.mood: Bouncy excitement, dazzling golden light, inviting mystery.

episode.endHook: Zoya’s watch sparkles again—where will their next adventure begin?
episode.description: Zoya and Tock sparkle into Kitty Hawk, USA, in 1903. A windblown paper glider leads them to discover the Wright brothers’ first powered aeroplane flight, which lasted 12 seconds!
